result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major loading indicator stuck on a restaurant card, and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner remains overlaid in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, suggesting the image is stuck loading or the spinner never dismissed
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads or the loading state is dismissed/removed after a timeout; hide the spinner once the image is rendered

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated at the right edge of the horizontally scrolling 'Fastest near you' section
issues.suggestion: Allow full name to wrap or add ellipsis styling, or ensure horizontal scroll reveals complete text
